purpose: Freeze the single Campaign118 top-decile amount-event spacing entropy definition, source, ordered no-return gates, complete finite comparison boundary, one development trial, execution assumptions and stop rules before opening Campaign118 values.

candidate.name: intraday_top_decile_amount_event_spacing_entropy_25g
candidate.economic_hypothesis: A wider distribution of the day's strongest fixed-count one-minute CNY-liquidity events may represent orderly participation and replenishment rather than one transient burst, carrying more persistent demand resilience from the next open through the third close.

exact_formula.amount_state: Use raw finite nonnegative amount with no transform, scaling, winsorization, normalization or percentile interpolation.
exact_formula.event_rule: Sort (amount,index) by descending amount then ascending zero-based selected-clock index and choose exactly 24 indices; earlier clock index wins an exact boundary tie.
exact_formula.gap_rule: For ordered event indices q_0<...<q_23, set g_0=q_0, g_i=q_i-q_(i-1)-1 for i=1,...,23, and g_24=239-q_23; the 25 nonnegative integer gaps sum to 216.
exact_formula.probability_rule: p_i=g_i/216 for all 25 gaps, retaining zero gaps.
exact_formula.support: Require exactly 240 finite nonnegative amount values, positive total amount, 24 distinct selected indices, 25 nonnegative integer gaps summing to 216, and a finite in-range score; zero amounts and deterministic exact ties remain valid; otherwise missing.

comparison_contract.direction_normalization: use every comparator's frozen score direction

ordered_no_return_gates.name: binding_source_snapshot_and_implementation_verification
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Before source values, bind this protocol, a pure formula implementation, tests, raw source, joint-clean source and output paths. After publication verify every partition byte/frame hash, exact projection/grid/formula/support/range/count and aggregate dataset digest.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: structural_coverage_variation_and_capacity_before_comparator_values
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: On the immutable quality/current-listing base require median daily coverage >=0.95, P05 daily coverage >=0.90, P05 eligible names >=50, at least 200 non-overlapping three-signal-session cohorts, at least five observed years, finite values in [0,1], and at least 200 nonconstant cross-sectional sessions. Failure stops before comparator value, daily price or forward return.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: all_135_numeric_uniqueness_after_coverage_only
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Compare in exact v106 numeric order with all 135 eligible numeric comparators. Each comparison requires at least 50 paired names per session and at least 100 qualifying sessions. Every absolute median daily average-tie Spearman rank correlation must be strictly below 0.8; insufficient overlap fails closed and no comparator may be removed.

finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.purge: Purge three signal sessions at every train/validation boundary; t+1 entry and t+3 exit must remain in the same partition.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.execution: Reuse the frozen one-factor next-open to third-close Top-3 engine, CNY 200000 board-lot pilot, quality/listing gates, amount-participation checks, 0/5/10/20bp stress grid, and survivor gates without override.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.stress_2024_2025: Open once for the whole campaign only if the sole trial survives every 2019-2023 development gate and a nonzero survivor record freezes the entire campaign; label it historically exposed quasi-out-of-sample. Otherwise leave it closed and unread.

next_action: Implement and synthetically test the exact formula without opening historical source values, then fingerprint-freeze code and tests before the one no-return snapshot build.
